title: AI-generated stories favour stability over change: homogeneity and cultural stereotyping in narratives generated by gpt-4o-mini

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the language model to generate 11,800 stories using 236 different national demonyms, followed by computational word frequency analysis, sentiment analysis, word tree visualizations, and qualitative close reading to identify surface-level stereotyping and the lack of distinct cultural representation.

Comparing the thematic elements, conflict resolution styles, and symbolic vocabulary (e.g., olive trees vs. trains) in stories generated for different countries to highlight how the model handles varying national identities.

Evaluating the underlying plot structures of AI-generated stories across all nationalities to demonstrate a deep structural homogenization where the model defaults to a single, conflict-averse, Anglo-American narrative template emphasizing stability and nostalgia.
